line1.speaker: Scratched into the rock
line1.text: This face is taller than one breath of ink. Nobody climbs it in one go.

line2.speaker: Scratched into the rock
line2.text: So draw what you can reach, then hold [shake]Q[/shake] and let go of yourself. What you drew will set.

line3.speaker: Scratched into the rock
line3.text: Come back and start from your own bones. That is how all of this was built.
